hero.headline: Fort Myers Beach Travel Guide
hero.subheadline: Treat Fort Myers Beach accurately as an incorporated town on Estero Island, not as a beach district of the mainland City of Fort Myers.

overview: Treat Fort Myers Beach accurately as an incorporated town on Estero Island, not as a beach district of the mainland City of Fort Myers.
The best itinerary stays focused on Estero Island beaches, preserves, Mound House, boating, and nearby state-park nature.

thingsToDo.title: Fort Myers Beach shoreline
thingsToDo.description: Use the Gulf beach for long walks, swimming, sunset, and the classic Estero Island experience.

thingsToDo.title: Lynn Hall Memorial Park and Times Square area
thingsToDo.description: Combine central beach access with the town's most active pedestrian and dining zone.

thingsToDo.title: Bowditch Point Park
thingsToDo.description: Head to the north end of Estero Island for beach, bay, and natural shoreline views.

thingsToDo.title: Mound House
thingsToDo.description: Visit the historic home and museum built over an ancient Calusa shell mound for essential island history.

thingsToDo.title: Matanzas Pass Preserve
thingsToDo.description: Walk mangrove and maritime-hammock trails for a quiet counterpoint to the developed beach.

thingsToDo.title: Lovers Key State Park — separate protected area
thingsToDo.description: South of town, this Florida state park is a regional nature excursion rather than Fort Myers Beach municipal parkland.

bestTimeToVisit.title: Cooler months are easiest for outdoor planning
bullets: Late fall through early spring generally brings lower humidity and comfortable outdoor conditions.
Summer is hot, humid, and storm-prone; start exposed activities early and keep afternoon plans flexible.
Busy winter and holiday periods reward advance reservations for popular tours and timed attractions.

travelTips: Group each day by geography instead of crossing the region repeatedly.
Use early mornings for exposed outdoor activities and waterfront time.
Check park, marine, and weather conditions before nature-focused plans.
Treat nearby municipalities and protected areas as separate destinations with their own access rules.

faq.q: How many days should I plan for Fort Myers Beach?
faq.a: Two to three days is a good starting point for the core sights plus one outdoor or regional experience.

faq.q: Is Fort Myers Beach good for outdoor travelers?
faq.a: Yes. The strongest itineraries combine the destination itself with nearby water, parks, preserves, or trails.
It depends on the destination, but a car or guided tour is often useful for protected lands and regional excursions.

faq.q: Should I book tours in advance?
faq.a: For high-demand wildlife, boating, park, and holiday-period experiences, advance booking is sensible.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: Fort Myers Beach is an incorporated town occupying much of Estero Island.

sections.heading: Geography & setting
paragraphs: The Gulf lies west and Estero Bay east, placing the town between open beach and mangrove-estuary environments.

sections.heading: History & culture
paragraphs: Calusa history, fishing, tourism, and hurricane resilience all shape the island's story.

sections.heading: Outdoor & seasonal highlights
paragraphs: Beach walking, boating, paddling, wildlife, and preserve trails dominate the outdoor experience.

sections.heading: Getting around
paragraphs: The island is linear; group north-end, central, and south-end stops to avoid repeatedly driving Estero Boulevard.
